text:
Yes, you can export your data at any time, and it's included on the free plan, so you don't need to upgrade.

You can download your data in two formats: CSV and JSON. CSV works best if you want to open your transactions in a spreadsheet program like Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers. There you can sort, filter and run your own analysis. JSON is a better fit for developers, or for moving your data into another app or tool that accepts structured data.

Exports are fast. Even a large history of 10,000 transactions takes less than two minutes to export. Smaller accounts usually finish in a few seconds. You can keep using the app while the export runs.

To start an export, go to your account settings and look for the data or export section. Choose CSV or JSON and confirm. When the file is ready, you can save it to your device.

Your data belongs to you. You can export it as often as you like, whether you're making a backup, reviewing your spending somewhere else or moving to a different service. There are no limits or extra fees.
